row.notes: ElasticSearch/telemetry message subscriber for R&D events: upgrade_research/development_purchased_message, upgrade_{research,development,adaptation}_cancelled_message, upgrades_update_failed_rnd_message, upgrade_adapted_message, UpgradeFittingChangedMessage, MessageESMyTeamFacilityUpgradePurchased, MessageRnDEndofWeekendResourcePointTotal, DriverPerkPurchased. onRnD* handlers near 0x1406da500. Hook surface for purchase/spend events; the RP -= cost write still needs a trace. CORRECTION(V9037): Strings confirm the R&D/facility messages (upgrade_research_purchased_message, MessageRnDEndofWeekendResourcePointTotal, DriverPerkPurchased, MessageESMyTeamFacilityUpgradePurchased) but the same 650KB function also registers many unrelated telemetry messages (session_enter, MessageFlashbackUsed, MessageCheckpointLoaded...); it is a general telemetry subscriber, R&D is a subset.
